text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Orfe, a present was delivered to our room 
earlier. Could it be another tribute from 
your 'loyal subjects'?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Nay. Rejoice, for this is a gracious gift 
to my elder sister. From myself, that is.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Orfe...! I should have thanked you 
the very moment I found you...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It matters not. The contents are teaware. 
I selected pieces from the kiln that my 
elder sister once mentioned having 
exceptional taste.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Orfe picked this out with his own 
hands...?! Ah, I'm sure it must be 
exquisite— Hehe, where should I display 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Put it on display? Why would you do such 
a thing? The true purpose of a tool is to 
be used."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I chose this item with careful thought 
toward how the tea brewed by my elder 
sister would taste, you see?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! That's right. Orfe picked out these 
tools for me, so I really have to use them 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you once again, Orfe. I promise to 
brew tea worthy of you every single 
day...!
